ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is a point on segment AB, point M is the midpoint of segment AC, and point N is the midpoint of segment BC. It is known that $AM = \frac{5}{4}BC = 5\,\text{cm}$. What is the length of MN in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $M$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$,\\
$\therefore AM=CM=5\text{cm}$, $BC=4\text{cm}$.\\
Also, since $N$ is the midpoint of segment $BC$,\\
$\therefore CN=\frac{1}{2}BC=2\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore MN=MC+CN=\boxed{7}\text{cm}$.
